policy_decisions.page_policy: Bound PDF gold rows must carry expected_file_name, page_no, and physical_page_index. page_label is recorded when available but does not replace numeric page identity.
policy_decisions.bbox_policy: Text/table/OCR block gold may require bbox overlap; page/document summaries may omit bbox. A page-level hit without bbox is not a strict paragraph-bbox match.
policy_decisions.table_policy: PDF table lookup rows require explicit policy review when current evidence is paragraph/page bound. They are relabel candidates before retrieval tuning.
policy_decisions.ocr_policy: OCR block evidence must retain ocr_used and confidence/trust metadata. Rows without required OCR confidence remain lower-trust/policy-excluded candidates.
policy_decisions.generic_query_policy: Generic PDF queries can remain diagnostic, but specific page/bbox expectations should be relabeled when top-k evidence shows a policy or chunk mismatch rather than pure ranking failure.
